Date
3rd June, 1940.

M. Fischer, Esq.,
Consul-General for Germany,
2, Peking Road,
Shanghai.

Sir,

I have the honour to acknowledge receipt
of your letter dated May 29, 1940, in which you make
reference to an article appearing in the "China Press".
The Council shares your disapproval of the
publication of any articles that may stir up ill-feeling
in the international community here. I am arranging
that this matter be brought to the attention of the
newspaper concerned, but I should point out that the
newspaper in question is subject to American legal
jurisdiction.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient Servant,

G. Godfrey Phillips

Secretary & Commissioner General.

M. Fischer 先生，
德国总领事，
上海北京路2号。

先生：

谨此确认收到您1940年5月29日的来信，信中提及刊登在《字林西报》（China Press）上的一篇文章。工部局与您一样，不赞成发表任何可能在此地国际社会激起恶感的文章。我正安排将此事项提请有关报纸注意，但我须指出，该报受美国法律管辖。

此致
敬礼

您的顺从仆人，

G. Godfrey Phillips

秘书兼总办。

While I need not assure you that the
allegations in these articles are without any found-
ation, you will understand that I cannot but regard
such irresponsible utterances of local newspapers
with serious apprehension as they are bound to stir
up hatred and ill-feeling in the international
community of Shanghai. In the interest of peace
and order I, therefore, have the honour to request
that the Municipal Council will cause the newspapers
concerned to show more restraint in their utterances
and abstain from calumnious attacks on national
groups in this settlement.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,
M. Fischer
Consul-General for Germany.

电影解说员在谈到正在展示的荷兰和比利时防御工事时说，当纳粹士兵看到它们时会感到恐惧。我不记得他使用的确切措辞，但这些话表明他正陷入一种廉价的狂热之中。

我现在想起，我们本地的一位新闻播音员曾说，德国人永远无法攻克比利时的防御工事，而他正是在比利时被占领后说这番话的。

我想知道南京大戏院这家体面且现代化的电影院的管理层，是否意识到这场由盟军关于纳尔维克的吹嘘宣传所制造的整场演出是多么荒谬。

纳尔维克，天哪！而观众中的本地英国人竟厚颜无耻地为他们在影片中看到的景象鼓掌，就在他们那支常胜之师被彻底赶出挪威、留下

pages.en:
- 2 -

French, the Norwegian and Polish Armies to hold on and
continue the fighting while all that the British
contributed was the demolition of Norwegian towns with
long range guns.

On April 11 a report read: "The British
have captured Norwegian ports." That presumably
included Narvik. Three cheers for Churchill, the
great liar.

On April 13 Churchill declared that the
report of the capture of Norwegian ports was not true.
That, again presumably, included Narvik. So that
somebody must have been lying. This lying must be
a hard job.

"Persen, the little rat, the Miniature Viking."

K.A. Persen, the little rat, the miniature
Viking, who has been broadcasting over the local
French Radio Station during the past two months, would
go and do it again.

This retreat and double retreat, this
occupation and re-occupation of Narvik without a
single loss is one of the colossal blunders committed
by Churchill.

The day will arrive when Churchill, H.B.M.'s
First Bricklayer, will be broadcasting from Ottawa
that the entire Cabinet had safely arrived in Canada
pages.zh:

法国、挪威和波兰军队坚守并继续战斗的五六天前，而英国人所做的贡献仅仅是用远程火炮摧毁挪威城镇。

4月11日有一则报道写道：“英军已占领挪威港口。”这大概包括纳尔维克。为伟大的骗子丘吉尔欢呼三声。

4月13日，丘吉尔宣称占领挪威港口的报道不实。这大概又包括了纳尔维克。所以肯定有人在撒谎。这撒谎一定是件苦差事。

“佩尔森，小老鼠，微型维京人。”

K.A. 佩尔森，这只小老鼠，这位微型维京人，在过去两个月里一直通过本地法国广播电台进行广播，现在又要故技重施了。

这次撤退和双重撤退，这次在零伤亡情况下对纳尔维克的占领和重新占领，是丘吉尔犯下的巨大错误之一。

总有一天，丘吉尔，英王陛下的首席泥瓦匠，会从渥太华广播说，整个内阁已安全抵达加拿大，

pages.en:
again without a single loss, and that his private
war is to be started now in earnest with all the
shabby rest of the army the Empire can command.
Flask: A telegram reports: "The French
Government is being earnestly urged to go to Quebec,
while the British Government will be accommodated at
Montreal. The preparations in Canada for the two
Governments are proceeding faster than the defence
work in London. The space in Ottawa is being found
to be insufficient and the Canadian Government has
refused requests for asylum, due to lack of space,
from Silesie, Queen Wilhelmina, King Haakon, the
Duchess of Luxemburg and others who are seeking to go

Shanghai may yet have the benefit of the
presence of royalty who would be welcomed by a certain
celebrated financier who hails from Bagdad. The
intrusion of the aristocratic, if slightly worn out,
royalty would no doubt cheer up the spirits of the
British community.
Abbott defined as "nothing but a nothing."
A local new-caster who speaks of jelly,
coffee, portable typewriters, raisin bread and well
known people in the same breath, has not only been
criticizing but making insulting remarks about famous
men, from the Fuehrer to Colonel Lindbergh.
pages.zh:
再次实现零伤亡，并且他的私人战争现在要动用帝国所能调集的所有残兵败将认真开始了。
弗拉斯克（Flask）：一则电报报道：“法国政府正被迫切促前往魁北克，而英国政府将安置在蒙特利尔。加拿大为两国政府所做的准备工作比伦敦的防御工作进展得更快。渥太华的空间被发现不足，加拿大政府因空间不足拒绝了西里西亚（Silesie）、威廉明娜女王、哈康国王、卢森堡女大公及其他寻求离开英国的人士的避难请求。”
上海或许还能受益于某些王室成员的到来，他们将受到一位来自巴格达的著名金融家的欢迎。这些贵族气息虽略显陈旧的王室成员的闯入，无疑会振奋英国侨民的精神。
阿博特（Abbott）被定义为“一无是处”。
一位本地新闻播音员在同一口气中谈论果冻、咖啡、便携式打字机、葡萄干面包和知名人士，他不仅一直在批评，而且对从元首到林德伯格上校等名人发表侮辱性言论。

Considering the fact that he has all along
been flinging mud at Hitler, King Leopold and
Mussolini, his attack against these people is
understandable, but I would like to know what the
American community thinks of his impudence when he
directs bitter criticism against such decent Americans
like Colonel Lindbergh who has done more for the

Alcott once paid me the compliment of
calling me a plain Nazi. As he knows what I am and

(After a pause): Germany is fighting for

鉴于他一直向希特勒、利奥波德国王和墨索里尼泼脏水，他对这些人的攻击是可以理解的，但我想知道美国侨民社区对他如此厚颜无耻地严厉批评像林德伯格上校这样体面的美国人作何感想，林德伯格上校为美国国家和美国航空事业所做的贡献比任何人都多，他的名字不应与这位新闻播音员相提并论。

奥尔科特（Alcott）曾恭维我，称我为一个纯粹的纳粹分子。既然他知道我是谁以及我主张什么——并为此感到自豪——我将告诉你这个泼脏水者的立场：他不过是一无是处之辈。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTRY
June 18 No 540 B. D. 141/2
Date ____ 19 6

Commissioner of Police.

Sir,

Reference the letter dated June 11 from the
Consul General for Germany to the Secretary-General
of the Council, the Consul General complains of an
article which appeared in 'the Sin Wan Pao Evening
Edition on June 4 referring to the "Fifth Column".
The contributor of this article has been traced
but not yet actually interviewed. He is a Chinese
and apparently a school teacher by profession.

This complaint raises a very difficult question. On May 1,
1939, the Council issued Notification No. 5092 which
prohibits the dissemination of political propaganda by
organized associations. This notification obviously
referred to the Sino-Japanese dispute and not to European
Powers or politics. The Consul General for Germany
considers that the article "Fifth Column" may stir up
ill-feeling in the international community in Shanghai,
but the Consul General has overlooked pro-German propaganda
appearing in the Ostasiatischer Lloyd and the scurrilous
comment of German citizens when broadcasting over Station
XHHB. I attach herewith a report in respect of a
commentary delivered between 7.45 p.m. and 8 p.m. June 17
over Station XHHB and copies of the Ostasiatischer Lloyd
dated March 1, March 30, April 1, April 9 and April 18, 1940.

（批：Filed A 38/2）

R. J. Yorke.
D.C. (Special Branch)

6月18日 第540号 B.D. 141/2

警务处处长。

先生：

关于德国总领事于6月11日致工部局秘书长的信件，总领事投诉6月4日《新闻报》晚刊上刊登的一篇提及“第五纵队”的文章。
该文章的撰稿人已被追踪到，但尚未实际面谈。他是中国人，显然是一名教师。

该投诉提出了一个非常棘手的问题。1939年5月1日，工部局发布了第5092号通告，禁止有组织的团体散布政治宣传。该通告显然指的是中日争端，而非欧洲列强或政治。德国总领事认为，“第五纵队”一文可能会在上海的国际社会中激起恶感，但总领事忽略了出现在《东亚劳埃德报》（Ostasiatischer Lloyd）上的亲德宣传，以及德国公民在XHHB电台广播时的下流评论。兹附上关于6月17日晚7点45分至8点在XHHB电台播出的一篇评论的报告，以及1940年3月1日、3月30日、4月1日、4月9日和4月18日的《东亚劳埃德报》副本。

（批注：归档 A 38/2）

R. J. Yorke.
副督察（特别科）

June 18, 1940. S. B. D.
Date ____

D. C. (Special Branch)

Sir,

In accordance with your instructions
I called on Mr. Clubb at the American Consulate
this morning. Mr. Clubb stated that neither the
Jin Wan Pao (Evening Edition) or the China Press
are registered at the Consulate and that no action
is contemplated in connection with the articles
complained of by the German Consul General.

Mr. Clubb added that Dr. Ferring of the
German Consulate called on him a few days ago in
connection with this matter and that the German
Consul General had telephoned him regarding the
articles complained of and that they had been
informed that the papers were not registered with
the American Consulate.

Mason Supt:
P.A. to D.C. (Sp.Br.)

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE S. B. REGISTRY No. S. B. D. 9417 Date June 17, 1940）
REPORT
Subject. Sin Wan Pao Evening Edition - Objectionable article
appearing on June 4, 1940.
Made by. P. J. Pharazyn Forwarded by Supt. Eason

With reference to the attached translation
of an article entitled "The Fifth Column" from the
Sin Wan Pao Evening Edition of June 4, 1940, Mr. Yao
Chun-nyoh (姚君玉), Assistant Manager of the paper,
was called to Headquarters on June 17. Upon being
questioned as to the source of the article
(manuscript attached), he explained that the article
was contributed by one Huang Yin-nyien (黄影呆),
who gave his address as follows:-
Huang Yin-nyien,
No.8 Dah Yue Li (Lane 769),
Gordon Road.

This address was visited by the undersigned
and C.D.C. 230 Chang Yeh on the afternoon of June 17,
but it was found that Huang had already removed to
an unknown address. However, he was stated by the
new tenant to be a teacher at the Ping Hai Middle
School (滨海中学), 183 Nanyang Road. This school
was visited but it was found that Huang was absent
and that his address was unknown. However, he
will be returning to the school on June 21st, and
endeavours will then be made to obtain his presence
at this office.

Mr. Yao, Assistant Manager of the Sin Wan
Pao, later this afternoon made further enquiries and
discovered that Huang Ying-nyien has another address,
No.9 An Leh Fong (安乐坊), Connaught Road. This
will also be visited by C.D.C. 230.

（印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处 特别科登记簿 编号 S. B. D. 9417 日期 1940年6月17日）
报告
事由：《新闻报》晚刊 - 1940年6月4日刊登的不当文章
呈报人：P. J. Pharazyn 转呈人：Eason 巡官

关于附上的1940年6月4日《新闻报》晚刊中题为《第五纵队》一文的译文，该报副经理姚君玉先生于6月17日被召至总部。当被问及文章来源时（手稿附后），他解释说该文章由黄影呆投稿，其地址如下：
黄影呆，
戈登路大悦里8号（769弄）。

本报告签署人及华人侦探警长230号张叶于6月17日下午走访了该地址，但发现黄已搬至未知地址。然而，新房客称他是南洋路183号滨海中学的教师。经走访该校，发现黄不在校内，且其地址不明。不过，他将于6月21日返回学校，届时将设法让他来到本办公室。

《新闻报》副经理姚先生当天下午稍晚时候进行了进一步查询，发现黄影呆还有另一个地址，康纳脱路安乐坊9号。华人侦探警长230号也将走访该地址。

File No. __________ POLICE FORCE FOR COMMENT __________
COPY 11 JUN 1940
758

German Consulate-General. Shanghai, June 11, 1940.

Sir,

I have the honour to acknowledge receipt of your letter of June 3rd and note with satisfaction that the Municipal Council is sharing my disapproval of the publication of any articles that may stir up ill-feeling in the International Community here. I further beg to thank you for bringing this matter to the attention of the newspaper concerned.

Regarding the status of the "China Press" there seems to be reason for doubt whether this newspaper really is subject to American legal jurisdiction as it is to my knowledge not registered with the local Consulate-General of the United States. If this information is correct it should be in the same position as for example the "Hua Mei Wan Pao" against which the Council at various occasions has taken administrative measures for lack of restraint in its publications.

I take this opportunity to draw your attention to articles of several other Chinese newspapers similar to those published recently in the "China Press". I am enclosing one taken from the "Hsin Wan Yeh Pao" which deals with alleged spy activities of German Clubs and German Chambers of Commerce. As the Municipal Council has ways and means at their disposal to control the local Chinese papers efficiently I should be obliged if you would arrange that these papers be warned against a repetition of such unfounded and offensive utterances.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

(sgd) M. Fischer
Consul-General for Germany.

G.G. Phillips, Esq.,
Secretary & Commissioner General,
The Shanghai Municipal Council.

德国驻上海总领事馆。1940年6月11日，上海。

先生：

谨此确认收到阁下6月3日的来信，并满意地注意到工部局与我一样，不赞成刊登任何可能在此间国际社群中激起恶感的文章。此外，感谢阁下将此事提请有关报纸注意。

关于《字林西报》（China Press）的地位，似乎有理由怀疑该报是否真的受美国法律管辖，因为据我所知，它并未在美国驻当地总领事馆注册。如果此信息属实，则该报应处于与《华美晚报》（Hua Mei Wan Pao）相同的地位，后者曾因刊载内容缺乏克制而多次遭到工部局采取行政措施。

借此机会，提请阁下注意其他几家中文报纸上发表的、与近期《字林西报》所刊类似的文章。随函附上从《新晚报》（Hsin Wan Yeh Pao）摘录的一篇，该文涉及所谓德国俱乐部和德国商会的间谍活动。鉴于工部局拥有有效管控本地中文报纸的手段和方法，如能安排警告这些报纸不得再发表此类毫无根据且具冒犯性的言论，我将不胜感激。

此致
敬礼

（签名）M. Fischer
德国总领事

G.G. Phillips 先生，
秘书兼总办，
上海公共租界工部局。

pages.en:
The Sin Yan Evening Edition on June 4 published the
following article written by Huang Ying-nyien (黄影采) :-

THE FIFTH COLUMN

During these few days, we have frequently read
the expression "The Fifth Column" in the newspapers. It
seems that this expression is very new. As a matter of
fact, the so-called "Fifth Column" is a spy organization but
the use of the new expression causes more attention and makes
the people more afraid.

Now I am writing the following about the activities
in the world of the "Fifth Column", that is regarded by the
people as dreadful as a devil :-

(1) Poland

Prior to the invasion of Poland by Germany, the
"Fifth Columnists" had already been active there, formed Nazi
organizations, established newspaper offices, fabricated
rumours recklessly and undertaken political work of various
kinds.

(2) Switzerland

Several years ago, "Koo-S-Te-Lo-F" (古斯脱洛夫),
leader of the "Fifth Column" who was most active in Sweden,
was assassinated by Jews. This drew the attention of the
world on account of his activities in Sweden. However up to
the present, the "Fifth Columnists" have still been active in
Switzerland. In view of the grave situation of the world at
present, the Swiss authorities are taking a hand to clear out
the "Fifth Column".

(3) Hungary

Most of the Germans in Hungary are farmers
whose political significance is very small. For this reason,
the activities of the "Fifth Columnists" in Hungary are directed
at the instigation of the German farmers.
pages.zh:
6月4日出版的《新晚报》晚刊刊登了黄影采撰写的以下文章：-

第五纵队

这几天，我们在报纸上经常看到“第五纵队”一词。看来这个说法很新颖。事实上，所谓的“第五纵队”是一个间谍组织，但使用这个新名词引起了更多关注，也使人们更加恐惧。

现将世人视如魔鬼般可怕的“第五纵队”在世界各地的活动情况记述如下：-

(1) 波兰

在德国入侵波兰之前，“第五纵队分子”已在那里活跃，组建纳粹组织，设立报社，肆意制造谣言，并进行各种政治活动。

(2) 瑞士

几年前，在瑞典最为活跃的“第五纵队”领袖“古斯脱洛夫”（Koo-S-Te-Lo-F）被犹太人刺杀。由于他在瑞典的活动，此事引起了世界的关注。然而截至目前，“第五纵队分子”在瑞士依然活跃。鉴于目前世界局势严峻，瑞士当局正着手清除“第五纵队”。

(3) 匈牙利

匈牙利的德意志人大多是农民，其政治意义很小。因此，“第五纵队分子”在匈牙利的活动旨在煽动德意志农民。

pages.en:
(2)

(4) Roumania
The Germans in Roumania are 4 or 5 of the whole
population of the people of Roumania. The "Fifth Columnists"
in this country are also very active. Germans have entered
the service of City Governments in many large cities; they
are energetically engaged in propaganda work.

(5) America
As to German subjects in America, they have two
organizations entitled "The Friends of New Germany" and "The
American Democratic League". The "Fifth Columnists" were
once very active. Several years ago, their plot was discovered
by the American authorities who made energetic efforts to clear
them out. The so-called "Nazi Spy Net" was thus broken by the
American authorities.

(6) England
Recently, Britain has discovered that the "Fifth
Columnists" were hiding in various large cities to engage in
the obstruction of communications, the instigation of labour
disputes, etc. Even, certain Germans, posing as Dutch refugees,
entered England in order to undertake spy work. Concerning this,
the English people have commenced strict precautions.

(7) France
As for the activities of the "Fifth Columnists"
in France, besides the German subjects many French people who
revolted against their own country worked for the enemy.
These traitors are not in favour of a war with Germany but are
induced by the Germans with money.

(4) 罗马尼亚

罗马尼亚的德意志人占罗马尼亚总人口的四五分之一。该国的“第五纵队分子”也非常活跃。德意志人已进入许多大城市的市政府任职；他们积极从事宣传工作。

(5) 美国

至于美国的德国臣民，他们有两个组织，名为“新德国之友”和“美国民主联盟”。“第五纵队分子”曾经非常活跃。几年前，他们的阴谋被美国当局发现，美方大力努力将其清除。所谓的“纳粹间谍网” thus 被美国当局打破。

(6) 英国

最近，英国发现“第五纵队分子”藏匿于各大城市，从事破坏通讯、煽动劳资纠纷等活动。甚至有一些德意志人伪装成荷兰难民进入英国，以从事间谍工作。对此，英国民众已开始采取严格的防范措施。

(7) 法国

至于“第五纵队分子”在法国的活动，除了德国臣民外，还有许多背叛自己国家的法国人为敌人效力。这些叛徒并不赞成对德作战，而是受到德国人的金钱利诱。

(8) 中国

据外文报纸报道，这几天上海也有“第五纵队分子”的活动，尽管尚无确证。由于德国俱乐部和商会的新组织散布在中国各地，我们一直认为

(9) Others

Judging from the past conditions, there were
activities of the "Fifth Columnists" beforehand regarding the
amalgamation of Germany and Austria, the annexation of
Czecho-Slovakia and the casting of votes in the Memel area.
Therefore, when the incidents occurred, the "Fifth Columnists"
had already engaged in creating disturbances according to
well-arranged schemes.

(9) 其他

从过去的情况来看，在德国与奥地利合并、吞并捷克斯洛伐克以及在梅梅尔地区投票之前，就有“第五纵队分子”的活动。因此，当事件发生时，“第五纵队分子”已经按照精心策划的方案从事制造骚乱的活动。
